_variant_note: Axis-3: customer references a request by description ('complaint about wrong charges') rather than by request_id. Model must call get_all_requests and identify the charges_dispute request by matching the description.

setup.persona: 25-year-old female, Priest, rural Birbhum, West Bengal

user_turns.content: What's the status of my complaint? The one about the wrong charges on my account.

get_all_requests._comment: Two requests — one about wrong charges, one about address update. Model must identify or ask which.

records.description: Dispute for incorrect maintenance charge of Rs 500 on savings account
Request to update communication address to new residence

get_all_requests._comment: Must fetch requests to identify the complaint. Asking 'which request?' without calling is acceptable; calling and then identifying the right one is also acceptable.

get_card_details._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

calculate_emi._comment: Noise tool — optional, not needed for this case.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks about 'the complaint about wrong charges' — a vague descriptor. The assistant should call get_all_requests to retrieve the customer's requests. Among them, REQ-GAR-001 (charges_dispute, in_progress) matches the description. The assistant must report that request's status (in_progress, last updated 14 Aug) rather than simply asking 'which request?' without looking. Calling the tool to ground the answer is expected; answering without the call or reporting the wrong request fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: calls get_all_requests, identifies the charges_dispute request (REQ-GAR-001, in_progress) from the description, and reports its status. Answering without the tool call, or reporting the wrong request, fails.
